matches.rationale: Finding 1 correctly identifies the sign error in Rodrigues' formula at Equation 3, noting that (1+cosθ) should be (1-cosθ). This directly detects the mathematical error in the rotation matrix that breaks orthogonality.

Finding 2 identifies the undefined βt parameter in Equation 1's forward process (zt = αt z0 + βt δt ε), noting it creates inconsistency with the variance condition. This detects the same undefined notation issue described in the ground truth.
No finding addresses the dimensional inconsistency in zmotion (R^{k×5×h×w} vs R^{k×3×h×w}). Neither finding discusses tensor shape mismatches or concatenation dimension errors in Section 3.2.
